remaining.quote: As of mid-October 2026, per fund data reported by Stock Analysis, Procure Space ETF (UFO), ARK Space & Defense Innovation ETF (ARKX), and Tema Space Innovators ETF (NASA) allocate significant portfolio weights to SpaceX.
Maximum exposure to SpaceX equity and private vehicles
The remaining $839.50 is spread across satellite radio providers, navigation hardware makers, and launch contractors such as Rocket Lab.
The remaining $888.40 goes to defense equipment manufacturers like L3Harris and Kratos, agriculture equipment makers like Deere, and enterprise tech firms like NVIDIA and Alphabet.
Portfolio concentration determines how closely your returns track a single business versus the broader aerospace economy.
When an ETF concentrates more than half its assets in ten companies, poor performance from two or three holdings will drag down your entire position.
Tema Space Innovators ETF (NASA) carries the heaviest concentration among the group, with 67.45% of its portfolio in its top ten holdings.
This gives investors significant exposure to SpaceX equity and indirect SPV holdings.
Its top ten holdings make up 55.82% of assets, including Rocket Lab, Viasat, and Globalstar.
ROKT offers the lowest top ten concentration at 38.10%, spreading assets across its broader aerospace mix.
An expense ratio represents the annual fee an ETF issuer deducts from fund assets to cover management, operations, and administration.
This fee is not billed directly to your brokerage balance; instead, it reduces the net asset value of the fund on an ongoing basis.
You also gain automated rebalancing, as the fund issuer handles corporate actions and adjusts weights periodically.
In exchange for this diversification, you pay an annual expense ratio of 0.45% to 0.75%, and your returns will be diluted by lagging holdings in the basket.
Portfolio weights inside exchange-traded funds fluctuate every business day based on market moves, inflows, and redemptions.
The weights published across financial websites often differ depending on when each platform refreshes its portfolio data.
